payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed information about the dataset collection methodology for CoVoST, including the sources and processes used to ensure quality and diversity.

claims.text: The CoVoST dataset was created from 11 languages into English, utilizing over 11,000 speakers and more than 60 accents, with a total of 708 hours of speech collected.
An evaluation set was constructed from the Tatoeba corpus, filtering for quality and sentence length to ensure relevance to real-world scenarios.
Both CoVoST and Tatoeba datasets were created at the sentence level without requiring additional alignments or segmentation.
